title: Per-call failure parameter
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a rational failure parameter $ ailure\in(0,1/2]$, define the per-call failure parameter to be $ ailure/C(k)$, where $C$ is the binary tree call count.
hypotheses_covered: The failure parameter is rational and belongs to $(0,1/2]$
